project_overview.project_name: Custom Beverage Mixing Device Prototype (DJ-Style Matcha Mixer)
project_overview.project_summary: This engineering design project centers on Custom Beverage Mixing Device Prototype (DJ-Style Matcha Mixer). The initial brief says: We are looking for a mechanical/product engineer to help design and prototype a custom beverage mixing device for live event use. This device is a dual-station matcha mixing system inspired by DJ turntables, designed to create a visually engaging experience while mixing powdered beverages (matcha). The work sits mainly in Electronics and PCB engineering, Architecture, CAD, and engineering documentation, Web, Mobile & Software Dev. Stable project themes include technical design, validation and review, production or approval documentation. The available evidence includes 260 conversation messages, 3 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .pdf formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For technical onboarding, the key task is to trace functional requirements into the editable design, review checks, physical or compatibility constraints, and production/approval outputs. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
